title: Uniquely Yeasty Venezuelan Knafeh Flatbread
description: This Venezuelan flatbread combines the flaky texture of knafeh with the adventurous spirit of wok-hei, making it a unique and delicious treat that is also Buddhist-temple-friendly, featuring no animal products or byproducts.

ingredients.name: knafeh dough
ingredients.notes: usually found in middle eastern markets

instructions: Combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl and stir until well combined.
Gradually add in the wok hei oil and sesame oil, stirring with a wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough into a large circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the knafeh dough on top of the rolled out dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the knafeh to form a crust.
Brush the top of the flatbread with a little bit of wok hei oil.
Bake the flatbread in a preheated oven at 400 degrees for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and garnish with chopped scallions.
Let the flatbread cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
